title: Influence of a Normalized-Sum Polynomial
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $P_n$ be the multilinear coefficient family equal to $1/\sqrt n$ on singleton subsets and zero on all other subsets, and evaluate it on the Boolean cube using the Walsh characters. The influence of coordinate $i$ in this evaluated function is $1/n$.
replaced: For $n\ge0$ and a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $f(x)=n^{-1/2}\sum_j(-1)^{x_j}$ on the uniform Boolean cube. Its influence $\mathbb E(D_i f)^2$, with $D_i$ the coordinate half-difference, equals $1/n$.
